title: Start anchored seat removal from both detail screens and finalize the register atomically

outcomes.statement: Group Admin starts one anchored left_company or inactive removal from person or request detail; execution selection creates a pending remove action without provider dispatch; the checklist path confirms through one shared domain finalizeOffboarding primitive and atomically closes the register, completes the action and transitions offboarding to deprovisioned while preserving Person.status.
outcomes.demo: Both detail screens target the authorized anchor. Checklist confirmations for left_company and inactive close the correct assignment on the Ecuador confirmation date and audit once. Reallocated is refused as transfer; unconfirmed action leaves register open; replay/concurrent confirmation cannot duplicate close/transition/audit; foreign anchor and wrong role are refused. Connector-backed selection creates pending automated remove and leaves request offboarding without provider call. No optimistic capacity mutation.

uncertainties.statement: How is finalization portable, atomic and replay-safe within three real scopes?
uncertainties.resolution: Domain finalizeOffboarding goes in existing exported packages/domain/src/request-workflow/lifecycle.ts. Web-owned adapter goes in existing modules/request-workflow/transition-core.ts using caller-owned LedgerTransaction and existing applyRequestTransitionInTransaction; packages/db remains unchanged. Domain controls authoritative locked reason/anchor/state validation and confirmation/replay; adapter atomically writes action confirmed, Ecuador-date assignment close, occurred_at transition and audit. Committed replay returns original evidence without rewriting reason/date or emitting another successful audit. Caller transaction covers the operation; failures roll back. Domain port permits US-082 to call the same primitive from its later persistence adapter without importing web code. Detailed portable interface awaits child design approval. Existing closure/action update grants suffice; a discovered grant/schema need adds a db scope and forces reassessment before implementation.

uncertainties.statement: Can existing contracts and checklist representation support the amended entrypoint?
uncertainties.resolution: Keep packages/contracts unchanged. Web-owned parsing extends the existing base input with optional requestId, retaining all base validation; parsed reallocated is explicitly refused with BR-02 message before writes. Request detail binds its own anchor; person detail explicitly selects an anchored seat using existing assignment data, avoiding silent person-wide removal. Validate request/person/company/account/license consistency from authoritative facts. Persist kind=remove/status=pending in BOTH automated and orchestration modes; reuse existing planner checklist payload and capability facts without provider call or dispatcher registration. Extend selection, confirmation and replay predicates in existing orchestration modules for remove/offboarding; provisioning checklist and invitation-only paths remain separate.

uncertainties.statement: How are the amended ACs interpreted and verified without discarding clauses?
uncertainties.resolution: Three acceptance flows cover audited targeted start/execution selection; checklist atomic close; rejection/replay/concurrency and tenant boundaries. All four canonical ACs map O1. AC4 connector-backed no state change is read together with AC1 as no COMPLETION beyond required active->offboarding, not a request remaining active; this bounded interpretation is explicitly included in the requested readiness approval. Unconfirmed/failed removal stays offboarding/register open; no provisioning_failure or provision failure transition. US-028 alone authorizes flagged_inactive->offboarding; normal action accepts active only. Existing multi-company group_admin authorization remains unchanged; foreign-anchor rejection tests mismatched server-resolved company/person/request/assignment and unauthorized roles rather than inventing a new tenant model.
